title: MedCraft local appsettings (extended)
description: Local development settings for MedCraft application appsettings files. Extends base appsettings.json with additional custom application properties that are only supported in development build configurations.

allOf.description: Configurations for local development build configurations.

NoAuth.description: An object that simulates user authentication information in the development authentication bypass configuration. Used to simulate specific users and roles without having to run through an actual 3rd party OIDC authentication.

Enabled.description: Enables the no-auth bypass. Only permitted in development build configurations.

DisplayName.description: Simulated user display name. Defaults to UserId when absent.

IsAdmin.description: Simulates user being assigned the custom Azure AD Administrator role, allowing all permissions. Set to false to smoke-test 403 behavior.

allOf.description: Mirrored base schema. Due to tag driven versioning, stable references are tricky as the version tag isn't applied until publishing. To solve,  mirror that definition here for any given verision.

UploadScanning.description: Configuration of file upload scanner service

Host.description: Host name of the upload scanner service

Port.description: Port on with the upload scanner service runs

Mode.description: Upload scanning mode. 'DisabledWithWarning' is runtime validated and only allowed in Development Mode. In Production, only 'Required' is allowed.
